stem.text: The compound potassium bismuthate(V), $\text{KBiO}_3$, is a powerful oxidising agent.
What is the significance of the (V) in potassium bismuthate(V)?

A.text: It is the oxidation number of the bismuth atom.

B.text: It is the charge of the bismuthate ion.

C.text: It is the oxidation number of the bismuthate ion.

D.text: It is the sum of the charges of the two ions present.
